clues.text: In Egypt, Joseph gave his second son this name, saying God made him fruitful in his affliction.
When Jacob blessed Joseph's two sons, he crossed his hands and put his right hand on this younger boy.
At the fords of the Jordan, Jephthah's men of Gilead asked each fugitive if he belonged to this tribe.
After Gideon routed Midian, men of this tribe argued with him hotly for not calling them to the fight.
Joshua was buried at Timnath-serah, in the hill country named for this tribe, north of Mount Gaash.
The prophet Hosea said this tribe mixes with the nations and is like a cake left unturned.
After Lazarus was raised, Jesus withdrew with His disciples to a town by this name near the wilderness.
